scopeAndLimitations: Only frontend files and Phase 12 evidence changed relative to the baseline. No new package dependencies.
429, extended analysis waiting, ERROR rendering, and Graph 404/503 were tested with intercepted responses. A live LLM analysis and deliberate production Neo4j outage were not triggered.
Live evaluation display uses existing saved reports; no evaluation records or answers were created or edited.
No remaining blocking UI issue observed in the tested flows. Initially stopped Phase 11 containers were restarted without configuration changes; cause of that pre-existing stop was not established.
